SaucerJamDown.escalate_when: two restarts fail for one incident, or a restart is accepted and /health does not recover inside the heal budget

SaucerJamHealthMalformed.escalate_when: /health answers 200 without a parseable status; a restart is not the remedy

SaucerJamHealthDegraded.escalate_when: ranking saves still failing after a restart; back up RANKINGS_FILE before any manual edit

SaucerJamRoomsSaturated.escalate_when: sustained saturation; raising MAX_ROOMS is a capacity decision needing headroom evidence (docs/HOSTING.md)

SaucerJamJoinFailureSpike.escalate_when: rate_limited or rooms_full dominates and does not self-clear

SaucerJamManyHumansPerRoom.escalate_when: host strained; lowering MAX_ROOM_PLAYERS is a human capacity decision

SaucerJamMemoryHigh.escalate_when: RSS does not fall after a restart (likely leak)

SaucerJamRankingSaveErrors.escalate_when: save errors continue; volume mount or permissions need a human

SaucerJamRateLimitStorm.escalate_when: single-IP abuse vs a stuck client cannot be distinguished automatically

SaucerJamPlayersStuck.escalate_when: friction ratio stays elevated with no reproducible code cause (design question)
